checks.title: Chemistry mismatch
checks.summary: The listing claims a 10-year shelf life for a zinc-carbon product. Published storage data for this chemistry runs to 4 years (at 4 years the handbook reports 65-80% of fresh service retained). A shelf life of 10 years is what alkaline datasheets state. The claim is unusual for the stated chemistry.
